_about: Approval records from decision to the card backlog, updated with Isa's answers of 27 Sep 2026. Dog-food build: no lab, no shadow periods, no trial dates. Baselines come from the pack's analysis and are replaced by live data and the actual costs the Owner enters. Gates 1 and 2 put the change on the backlog; Gate 3 records are signed just in time, before the cards that name them start. There are no named roles: the collective pulls the cards; AR-14 is a mechanical load. Gates 1 and 2 were signed by Isa on 27 Sep 2026 (AR-14 loads Phase 0); AR-09b and AR-10 remain just in time.

gates.name: Decide the idea
gates.purpose: Exit Idea stage. One sitting; all evidence exists.

gates.name: Onto the backlog
gates.purpose: Ratify the plan and its baselines, then load Phase 0 into the pull queue.

gates.name: Just in time
gates.purpose: Records the backlog itself waits on. Each is signed before the first card that names it starts.

gates.name: Amendments
gates.purpose: Changes to the signed constitution, each a new version ratified by Isa (principle 8).

records.title: Constitution
records.approves: The eight principles, the five golden allocation rules (G1-G5) and rules R1-R20, as extracted verbatim in this pack's constitution section.

records.title: Model portfolio
records.approves: The rolling policy (P1, P2, P6-P8) and the starting menu of seven models on API tokens (pack: menu). Replaces 'start from today's four models'.

records.title: Operating rules
records.approves: For the build and live use (H6 says 'for the trial'; there is no separate trial): the seven-model menu on API tokens, the Scaler (R14) with held demand counted, a 15-minute target, a 1-hour cost-band wait, quality floor 0.8 and cost band 1.5; no training on our data (R15); the burn cap (R16); R17-R19; and R20 for any searched configuration.

records.title: Budget and value measure
records.approves: An initial monthly ceiling of about $2,500 (claim CL-04), with R16's hourly cap at 2x the trailing seven-day average. Baselines come from the pack's cost model and are replaced by live metering and the actual costs the Owner enters (vendor invoices, subscriptions, cloud credits); the ceiling resets by R16's formula from actuals. Value in USD: each idea carries a baseline at intake and an actual from ratification to production and return (C0.09; M06, M07).
evidence: Isa, 27 Sep 2026: an idea is worth nothing without action

records.title: Exit Idea stage
records.approves: Move to design under the Amend scenario, through this pack.

records.title: Alignment Record and authority to ingest
records.approves: The intent of the change as stated in this pack (README: intent and scope), its assumptions (twin_parameters), experiments (X1-X14) and open items. Authorises loading the pack and nothing else until AR-13.

records.title: Quality standards and constants
records.approves: Initial maximum markdown rate per institution and tier, derived from the analysis: 1 minus the R19 floor for each step, so 20% for design, plan, plan red-team, security review, acceptance test and release; 40% for other steps; 50% for review [PROPOSED]. Adjusted from live variance (C0.11); any constant not fixed in the constitution.
records.signed_note: [PROPOSED] values accepted as proposed; live data may adjust them through AR-12

records.title: Owner of live operation
records.approves: Live operation is part of the Factory (Isa, 27 Sep 2026). The Ledger detects incidents; the owner restores by reverting the causing change; hotfixes are ordinary cards pulled by the Market and reviewed by Review; change-failure rate and restore time are marked against the releasing change. Until the Release Gate exists, incidents and restores are top-priority cards pulled by any agent and checked by another family; then the Release Gate owns them [PROPOSED]. This extends the Release Gate's charter: a constitutional amendment.
records.signed_note: [PROPOSED] values accepted as proposed; live data may adjust them through AR-12

records.title: Protected governance paths
records.approves: The protected path categories: constitution, charters, Ledger rules, Scaler and burn-cap settings, and this pack. The puller of C0.02 confirms the exact paths against the code. Interim gate until the Release Gate exists: a pass by an agent of another family than the author, plus Isa.

records.title: Monitoring and improvement plan
records.approves: No trial and no study period: the Factory is built, used at once on its own work, and improved from live data. What is measured (M01-M20); the weekly report and alarms (C0.15): live outside the model by more than 25% (X9), or any X1-X14 falsification criterion met, opens a card; amendments pass the Release Gate and Isa.

records.title: Ratified Plan
records.approves: The card seeds in this pack, phase by phase, with their dependency graph and acceptance contracts; every [PROPOSED] value accepted or changed. Later changes arrive as evidenced returns under R8, not as a pre-read report.
records.signed_note: [PROPOSED] values accepted as proposed; live data may adjust them through AR-12

records.title: Backlog admission
records.approves: Load the ratified Phase 0 cards into the pull queue, each carrying its pack card ID. A mechanical load: no agent chooses or assigns. Later phases load when the previous phase's exit is approved: through the interim gate for Phases 0-1, then through the Release Gate.

records.title: Ratification tiers and attention budget
records.approves: Which ideas need Isa's ratification, which the Council may ratify, and Isa's weekly attention budget.

records.title: Vendor and data terms
records.approves: The self-hosted gateway (C0.19) as the Factory's one model interface. API accounts with the menu's vendors held by the Owner. Routes: direct for the two anchors; OpenRouter as the first aggregator route, with the Owner's own keys (no fee below $25,000 a month of list-price use), sticky sessions and data collection denied per request; Vercel AI Gateway as a trial route (no platform fee; zero data retention per request) [Unverified: third-party guides, September 2026; confirm against current terms]. No-training terms confirmed for every tier and route used (R15); rate limits recorded as Scaler caps; Muse Spark availability for the Owner's account region [Unverified]; review of vendor and aggregator terms for Heliosvera IP by a qualified adviser where they are unclear, including any aggregator in the data path. Key custody: the Owner holds all keys, hashed in the Factory; an aggregator holds a vendor key only where the Owner registers it there for that route.

records.title: Amendment: quality, cost and speed; readiness hand-back
records.approves: R14 amended: the Scaler prices a success as ($ + time value x elapsed hours, latency included) / pass chance, weighing quality, cost and speed together; time value starts at $0.5 an hour [baseline] and moves on live evidence. New R21: every institution hands back cards that are not fit for purpose before any build spend. Human steps are timed stages, measured like any institution. New experiments X15 and X16; new measures M21-M23.

records.title: Amendment: institutions as harnesses; model flexibility; central memory
records.approves: Principle 9 (models are interchangeable) and principle 10 (memory is central; context is fresh). R22: each institution runs its own harness, and harness edits are predicted, trialled and adopted on evidence. R23: model swap by configuration. R24: fresh, cache-first context from the Ledger. Experiments X17-X19; measures M24-M25. Editorial: the reviewing institution is named Review.

after_backlog: A phase-exit approval for each phase (interim gate for Phases 0-1; Release Gate from Phase 2)
Amendment cards opened by the weekly alarms or a falsified experiment (C4.01), human-ratified, each as a new version
